title: Secure Financial Data Extraction
business: Financial institutions processing automated document analysis for client reports.
problem: Unintended exposure of sensitive PII or API keys within generated reports when agents interact with external data processing tools.
solution: Implementing tool guardrails that intercept function-tool inputs and outputs to scan for patterns like secret keys or PII, blocking the execution or redacting the output before it reaches the end user.
steps: Define a tool_input_guardrail function to inspect tool arguments for sensitive patterns before execution.
Define a tool_output_guardrail function to scan tool results for sensitive data after execution.
Attach these guardrails to the specific FunctionTool instances used for document processing.
Configure the agent to utilize these guarded tools, ensuring all data flows are validated at the tool boundary.
outcome: Automated prevention of data leakage, ensuring that sensitive information is never returned to the agent or the final user output.
limitation: Tool guardrails add latency to every tool invocation because they perform synchronous inspection; verify performance impact by monitoring the time taken for tool execution cycles.
